changelog.1.0.1: predict.py: whole-file analysis by default, segment_duration fed as constant 10.0, warning for windows < 3 s; model unchanged
changelog.1.1.0: feature pruning + retrain (137 trees): removed segment_duration, log_si/log_ti/log_motion, pixels (21 -> 16 features); label-space test VMAF MAE 3.65 vs 3.60 (statistically equivalent)
changelog.1.1.1: docs-only after external review: AV1 preset 10/12 note, CRF-ladder coverage table, corpus attrition note (21.7k -> 18,098), 'Reviewed and rejected' section (sample weighting + aspect feature tested, not adopted); model unchanged
changelog.1.2.0: calibrate.py added: probe-based calibration for custom encoder settings/presets/builds; predict.py gains --calibration and --crf-offset; FFMPEG/FFPROBE/VMAF env overrides; validated on held-out videos: delta -0.09 for the training preset (sanity), +3.05 for x264 medium; model unchanged
changelog.1.3.0: model UNCHANGED (old_prod kept): v4 retrain on the v4 table (v3 data + 14,359 hardcontent rows from 410 segments x 16 stress-test videos) evaluated head-to-head on the identical test split and REJECTED - no improvement (overall CRF MAE 1.722 vs 1.712, label-space VMAF MAE 3.67 vs 3.65); metrics.json gains the full experiment record; hardcontent gap quantified (both models -5.1 VMAF bias on hc); reproducible retraining pipeline archived at s3://kubakra-videos/ml-crf-vmaf/v4/
changelog.1.4.0: preset_delta Track 2 dataset released (v1.0): 5,471 rows = 27 validation clips x 4 codecs x full preset ladders (x264/x265 veryfast/fast/medium/slow, vp9 cu2/cu4/cu6, av1 p6/p8/p10/p12) x 4 resolutions (720p-2160p), measured VMAF + bitrate + encode time per cell; val_coral_b excluded (reference decode failure); 4 rows with vmaf=-1 dropped; dataset + generator + manifest archived at s3://kubakra-videos/ml-crf-vmaf/training_data/preset_delta_v1.0/; model and code unchanged
changelog.1.5.0: quantile model family: point prediction switched from L2-mean to median (q50) - label-space test VMAF MAE 3.52 vs 3.65 (-3.7%), E2E head-to-head on 8 unseen videos (307 paired cells): VMAF MAE 4.57 vs 5.12 (-10.7%), better on every codec and resolution, bias +0.15 vs +0.74; ships model_q10.txt/model_q90.txt for an 80% prediction interval (printed by default, --no-interval to suppress); calibration/--crf-offset now shift the interval too; rejected: monotone constraint on target_vmaf (+0.7% MAE cost) and per-codec models (av1/x265 regressions)

model.objective: quantile (alpha=0.5, median) - v1.5.0; previous releases used L2 regression
model.internal_lineage: model_t3_q50 (train_track3.py, table v4, split/seed/config identical to v1.1.0 B_pruned)

datasets.multicodec: 3,891 segment x resolution rows, 4 codecs, 5-point CRF ladders (x264/x265: 18-40, vp9/av1: 30-63)

training.label_generation: per-segment logistic CRF->VMAF fit (99.8% logistic, 0.2% linear fallback), inverted for integer targets 60-95, kept only within measured CRF ladder

interval_models.note: 80% prediction interval for CRF, loaded automatically by predict.py when present next to model.txt
